name: A Train Hitting a School Bus
look: Two panels stacked vertically from grainy video. Top: a yellow and gray freight locomotive rolls toward a yellow school bus stopped across the railroad tracks. Bottom: the locomotive slams into the side of the bus, which crumples and blurs as debris flies.
use: Something unstoppable flattens something that never saw it coming. The train is labeled with the overwhelming force and the bus with whatever gets wrecked, like plans, a diet or a good mood.
slots: label on the train: the unstoppable force
label on the school bus: what gets destroyed
examples: My savings plan for the month
